title: Doraemon (2005)
justification: TVDB 281405 numbers the 2005 series by year and counts the broadcasts AniDB files as specials among its regular episodes, so AniDB's numbers drift from TVDB's by one at every special and the absolute default fails throughout. Each AniDB episode and special is placed on the TVDB episode of its air date, one per broadcast, and the titles agree as translations: special S1 The Fishing Pond in My Room / The Time Machine Disappeared!! is season 1 episode 1, AniDB 1 Slow-Slow, Quick-Quick / Nobita's Wife is season 1 episode 2 Wriggle Slowly / Nobita's Bride, 49 Nobita's Drifting Chronicle is season 2 episode 24 Nobita's Castaway Story, 237 Gian Stew is season 8 episode 6, 682 is season 19 episode 32. Four dates differ and the titles decide: 172 Nobita's Survival Trip, 173 The Curse of the Laughing Doll and 174 Long Ago, Mom Was Just Like Nobita!? are season 6 episodes 11-13, and 337 Iruka ni Notte Umi no Tabi is season 11 episode 12 Take a Sea Voyage on a Dolphin. 28 specials (quizzes, selections, previews, and ten whose same-day TVDB episode carries another title) have no TVDB episode.
